specs/archive/902_reassess_lplus_ztime_nogo_cslib_omega_automata/plans/01 is a near-exact structural precedent for a report-only measurement task whose implementation phases are record work, task filings and a close-out summary. Four of its measured lessons (128KB --audit-verdict argv ceiling, --allocate-into reading membership not the cache, an unsatisfiable anchor-count criterion, the unset [IN PROGRESS] marker) were carried into this plan as up-front mitigations rather than rediscovered, saving a full planning exploration pass.

The plan's guardrail criteria name '<this task's first commit>', but 'git log --grep="^task 927"' returns six commits: three from 2026-11-13 (this task) and three from 2026-02-25 belonging to a PRIOR vault generation's task 927 ('fix status synchronization between plan files, TODO.md, and state.json'). Taking 'tail -1' as the first commit silently widened the diff to the entire repository history and produced a false guardrail-(b) violation (every FormalSystem file appearing as added). Resolved by scoping on commit date: this task's first commit is e30f23b81 (2026-11-13). Any future plan criterion phrased as '<this task's first commit>' derived from a task-number grep must be date-scoped.

The plan's Phase 2 carried a lesson from task 902 that state-write.sh --audit-verdict trips a 128 KB per-argv ceiling and that a multi-proposal audit file must be sliced per proposal. The audit file here is 349 KB (449 scope-blind corpus records per proposal). The ceiling no longer applies: state-write.sh now normalizes --audit-verdict through a private temp file and re-passes it via --argjson-file, explicitly to survive a large file (its own comment cites observed 145KB/159KB cases). Per-proposal slicing was still used, since each filing is a separate call needing only its own verdict line, but it was not forced by the ceiling. The 902 lesson is discharged as no-longer-binding rather than silently carried forward.

Phase 3's declared verification criterion names 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh' as the complete gate set, but that script compares the deployed .claude/ tree against the source store and this task touched no file under .claude/ or agent-system/ -- every finding it could produce would be pre-existing baseline, and no --only-gate N selection reaches specs/** artifact or state validity. Under the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive this is the UNMAPPABLE CRITERION case. Discharged by running the named checks directly, scoped to this phase's touched surfaces: run-all.sh --only over test-validate-artifact.sh, test-validate-state.sh, test-audit-task-proposals.sh (3 passed, 0 failed), plus validate-artifact.sh on both the plan and the summary and validate-state.sh, all exit 0. A report-only task whose whole output is under specs/** should name validate-artifact/validate-state suites as its full tier rather than verify-deploy.sh.
